title: Python
description: Gates for Python files, such as the scripts of skills. Ruff comes from the PATH. In a project managed by uv, write uv run ruff instead, to run the version the project pins.

gates.description: Lints the changed files with Ruff.

requires.install: uv tool install ruff, pipx install ruff, or brew install ruff

gates.description: Checks that the Ruff formatter leaves the changed files as they are.

requires.install: uv tool install ruff, pipx install ruff, or brew install ruff

gates.description: Fails on the rule suppressions the turn added, never on the ones already there: noqa, type: ignore, pylint: disable, fmt: off, nosec, no cover. The cheapest green is to silence the rule, and this is the gate that refuses it.
